covers: Symptom -> root cause -> fix history: auth (Google/Apple sign-in), routing/redirects, BFF, env/deploy. See troubleshooting-destinations.json for destinations-page/wizard/pricing-display bugs.

entries.symptom: Search Console lists /signin, /profile, and /checkout?package= as crawled, then excluded by noindex.
entries.root_cause: robots.ts disallowed only prefix-plus-slash (/checkout/). That does not match /checkout or /checkout?package=. Google could fetch the URL, then honored the page noindex.
entries.fix: Disallow each privateRoutePrefixes entry as the prefix itself so /checkout, /signin, and /profile cover the exact path, a trailing slash, and a query string. Keep noindex on those pages.

entries.symptom: Frontend deploy prints IndexNow ping failed 403 UserForbiddedToAccessSite, then ELIFECYCLE exit code 1, then Frontend deploy complete.
entries.root_cause: The key file at /f0cff59a140c9ed46080afdc578bf9f7.txt is public and exact. api.indexnow.org (Bing) still returns 403 when the Bing Webmaster property was imported from Google Search Console. Yandex accepts the same payload with 202.
entries.fix: Ping Yandex as well as Bing, and treat the deploy as successful when either accepts. To clear Bing's 403, re-verify esim.uplisoft.com in Bing Webmaster Tools with Bing's XML file instead of a Google import.

entries.symptom: pnpm build warns Failed to set Next.js data cache for https://esim.uplisoft.com/api/packages, items over 2MB can not be cached.
entries.root_cause: getDestinationOffer fetched the full catalog with next:{revalidate:3600}. Next's data cache has a 2MB cap; /api/packages is ~2.7MB.
entries.fix: Fetch /packages with cache:'no-store', cache only a slim per-country offer index via unstable_cache (3600s), and set export const revalidate = 3600 on /destinations/[slug].

entries.symptom: A traveler reply while /xsupport is open updates the unread badge but not the chat text or list preview.
entries.root_cause: support:message only appended when payload.threadId matched the selected thread, so a message keyed on message.threadId was dropped; the list preview was not patched from the live message.
entries.fix: Match live messages on payload.threadId or message.threadId, patch lastMessagePreview on the list, refresh unread, and alert when the admin is not looking at that thread.

entries.symptom: Clicking a photo in /xsupport opens a zoomed/cropped preview instead of the full image.
entries.root_cause: The lightbox img used max-h-full inside a CSS grid overlay. Grid items default min-height:auto to the image's intrinsic size, so a large photo overflowed the viewport and looked zoomed.
entries.fix: Cap the preview with max-h-[90vh] max-w-[90vw] object-contain in a flex overlay.

entries.symptom: Signed-out visitor on prod clicking a guarded link (e.g. /profile) lands on https://localhost:3020/signin?... (dead URL)
entries.root_cause: middleware built redirect URLs from url.origin, which Next resolves from the internal bind address (127.0.0.1:3020) not the Host header
entries.fix: derive all redirect URLs from getPublicOrigin(request); applied to src/middleware.ts and the auth refresh route

entries.symptom: Any /api/* Next route handler answers with Express's 'Cannot GET /api/...' in production only (works in dev)
entries.root_cause: nginx proxies the entire /api/* prefix to the Express backend before Next ever sees the request; per-path carve-out is impossible because BFF paths intentionally mirror backend paths (e.g. /auth/otp/send exists on both)
entries.fix: moved all route handlers from src/app/api/** to src/app/bff/** (git mv); repointed every browser call site; added /bff to seo.ts privateRoutePrefixes

entries.symptom: Apple sign-in button renders on /signin but fails immediately with invalid_client
entries.root_cause: NEXT_PUBLIC_APPLE_SERVICES_ID held a Google iOS OAuth client id (…apps.googleusercontent.com, copied from GoogleService-Info.plist) instead of an Apple Services ID; the render guard only checks non-empty, not validity
entries.fix: set NEXT_PUBLIC_APPLE_SERVICES_ID=com.uplisoft.velocityesim.web in .env.local and .env.production; also required creating the Services ID in Apple Developer portal (cannot be done from code) and adding APPLE_BUNDLE_ID/APPLE_SERVICES_ID to the backend .env

entries.symptom: Google sign-in fails ONLY in production with a generic 'Access blocked: Authorisation error... doesn't comply with Google's OAuth 2.0 policy' — works fine on localhost
entries.root_cause: that message is Google's generic body text for redirect_uri_mismatch; https://esim.uplisoft.com was missing from the OAuth client's Authorized JavaScript origins. Worked locally because Google ignores the port for localhost origins (masked that localhost:3000 wasn't registered either)
entries.fix: added https://esim.uplisoft.com to Authorized JavaScript origins in Google Cloud Console — NO code change

entries.symptom: Neither Google nor Apple button appears on /signin at all
entries.root_cause: SocialSignInButtons returns null when both NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID and NEXT_PUBLIC_APPLE_SERVICES_ID are empty; repo had no env file at all
entries.fix: added .env.local with NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID copied from backend's GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID (must match or backend rejects token aud); added .env.example documenting all vars

entries.symptom: Google sign-in button visually left-aligned instead of centered/full-width
entries.root_cause: Google Identity Services renders into a fixed-pixel-width iframe; CSS utility classes on the wrapper don't affect the iframe's own rendered width
entries.fix: measure the row with ResizeObserver, pass real pixel width to renderButton() (capped at Google's 400px max), re-render on resize

entries.symptom: A local .env.local change 'works on my machine' but has no effect after deploying with update.sh
entries.root_cause: .env.local is gitignored and never exists on the server; update.sh deploys via git pull then builds, so only committed env files (.env.production) reach prod
entries.fix: n/a — this is a standing operational trap, not a one-time bug; always mirror NEXT_PUBLIC_* additions into .env.production (and .env.example) if they must reach prod

entries.symptom: The Product Hunt banner on the homepage shows an old/outdated eSim2you logo even after the brand's local logo assets were updated
entries.root_cause: ProductHuntFeature (src/app/page.tsx) hot-linked its logo image from ph-files.imgix.net (a Product-Hunt-hosted snapshot taken at launch time) instead of using a local public/*.png asset, so it never picked up later logo changes
entries.fix: Point the section at public/logo-icon.png (same mark Navbar.tsx uses) instead of the ph-files.imgix.net URL; any future logo update to that asset now propagates here automatically

entries.symptom: A declined card during checkout showed a static red "Error!" panel with no card fields and no way to retry -- buyer had to reload /checkout and start over
entries.root_cause: CardStep.tsx mounted @nebula-ltd/pok-payments-js GuestCheckoutForm, whose internal render is error ? <ErrorPanel/> : ... : <Form/> with no reset prop -- once its onError fired, the packaged widget permanently unmounted its own card-number/expiry/CVV fields
entries.fix: Rebuilt CardStep.tsx with its own card inputs driven by the SDK usePOK hook instead of GuestCheckoutForm -- form state now lives in our component so a decline just shows an inline error banner above the still-populated, still-editable fields

entries.symptom: git commit is blocked by feedAI/check-health.sh (STALE commits, or the hook tells you to skip hooks)
entries.root_cause: A pre-commit hook copied by feedAI/install-hooks.sh (package.json postinstall) ran check-health.sh and failed when more than 5 commits since sync.date had not touched feedAI/
entries.fix: The hook is gone. install-hooks.sh, git-hooks/pre-commit, and the postinstall script were deleted. Commit normally. Do not reinstall the hook.

entries.symptom: /xsupport chat does not update live (or socket.io 404/polling loop) while REST through /bff/admin/support works
entries.root_cause: Socket.IO from the admin page talks to Express directly on /socket.io; nginx /api proxy does not cover that path, and Upgrade headers are required. backendFetch JSON helpers cannot be used for this channel.
entries.fix: Proxy location /socket.io/ to the backend container with HTTP/1.1 Upgrade/Connection headers; set NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL for local backends. Do not put Socket.IO under /bff.

entries.symptom: A logo PNG update is ignored by browsers/CDNs for up to a year
entries.root_cause: Stable /logo-icon.png and /app-logo.png URLs were given Cache-Control immutable max-age=31536000 while the bytes behind those names changed
entries.fix: Serve those two paths with public, max-age=3600, must-revalidate. Keep long immutable caching only for hashed /images/:path* assets.

entries.symptom: /xerrors inbox flooded with info/warning rows (401/400/429) or cURL shows Bearer <user-token>.
entries.cause: Inbox previously listed all status>=400 events; Authorization was never stored; severity 404 was info.
entries.fix: Always pass realFailuresOnly=true (404 / >=500 / critical). New events store authorizationHeader for replay cURL. PCI fields still redacted. Deploy backend migration for authorizationHeader.

entries.symptom: Checkout step 02 shows red 'return_url origin is not allowed' and no card fields (local next against production API).
entries.cause: BFF POST /bff/payments/intent was still sending return_url built from localhost; production POKPAY_WEB_RETURN_ORIGINS only allows https://esim.uplisoft.com.
entries.fix: Plan intent omits return_url (in-app CardStep does not redirect). Top-ups keep return_url. Reload /checkout after the BFF change (f173).

entries.symptom: /xerrors detail Backend response is N/A; replay cURL for /payments/intent with localhost return_url does not match expectations.
entries.cause: Backend never persisted ErrorEvent.backendResponse (tracker bug). The stored body with return_url=http://localhost:3000 correctly 400s with return_url origin is not allowed against production allowlist.
entries.fix: Deploy backend f209 so new rows store the JSON body. UI displayBackendResponse reconstructs from message for older rows. Plan checkout BFF already omits return_url (f173); replay without return_url to exercise the success path.

entries.symptom: Site footer Explore shows three 'Remote work eSIM guide' links and Resources shows three 'Travel eSIM installation guide' links.
entries.cause: Labels used a binary slug ternary with a catch-all fallback, while useCasePages grew to 4 and guidePages.slice(0,3) no longer matched the old what-is/esim-vs/install slugs.
entries.fix: Map each slug in footerUseCaseLabels / footerGuideLabels; fall back to page.heading for unknown slugs (f175).

entries.symptom: Admin edits a package's 'Minimum profit (cents)' or 'Affiliate commission %' in /xpartnersy, saves successfully, and nothing changes — the preview table doesn't react and real checkout gating is unaffected.
entries.cause: Both inputs were vestigial after the move to global PartnerProgramSettings: the backend never read the persisted per-package values for gating, and draftPreview computed safeFloor from companyFloorCentsDraft (the global program setting) rather than the per-package field beside it.
entries.fix: Removed both inputs, their AffiliateDraft/AffiliateConfig fields, and their PUT payload entries; added a note that floor/max come from program settings. Backend stopped accepting them too.

entries.symptom: A bff/dev/* helper route that mints session cookies is reachable in an environment it shouldn't be.
entries.cause: The route's only guard checked whether the server's own BACKEND_API_URL contained 127.0.0.1/localhost. That reads server config, not the request, so a production deploy misconfigured or proxied to a loopback backend passes the check and mints a session for any caller-supplied token pair.
entries.fix: Return 403 when process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' before any other check; keep the loopback check as a second condition.

entries.symptom: /esim/balkans, /esim/middle-east or /esim/south-america shows 'Live plans for this destination are loading or temporarily unavailable' permanently, with no Offer in JSON-LD.
entries.cause: backendCountryCode(slug) fell back to the public slug, but the backend /packages countryCode for those regions is europe / middle-east-and-north-africa / latin-america, so the catalog lookup found nothing.
entries.fix: Add the slug->region mapping to BACKEND_COUNTRY_CODE_BY_SLUG in src/lib/esim-routes.ts. Check the live codes with curl https://esim.uplisoft.com/api/packages before adding any new regional /esim page.

entries.symptom: A destination H1 reads 'eSIM for Ireland travel eSIM' and the page has no related-destinations block.
entries.cause: The slug exists in destinationPages (seo-pages.ts) but not in destinationDisplay, so destinationH1() returns null and the fallback builds the H1 from the page's own label.
entries.fix: Add the slug to destinationDisplay; esim-routes.test.ts now fails if any destination page is missing.

entries.symptom: On mobile the /destinations H1 reads 'Choose international databefore your trip begins.'
entries.cause: The only separator between the two lines was a <br className='hidden sm:block'>, which is display:none below 640px, and JSX drops the newline whitespace.
entries.fix:
Add {" "} before the responsive
. Apply the same pattern to any heading that uses a breakpoint-only
.

entries.symptom: Homepage CLS ~0.14 on mobile; Lighthouse blames the 'Search travel destination' box in the hero.
entries.cause: HeroDestinationChips returned null until its client-side fetchPackageGroups() resolved, then inserted ~3 rows of chips. The hero column is flex justify-center inside min-h-[640px], so the added height re-centered everything and shifted the search box up.
entries.fix: Render aria-hidden placeholder pills (CHIP_PLACEHOLDER_WIDTHS, h-[38px]) while popular===null; return null only once loaded and empty. Any client-loaded block inside a vertically centered hero must reserve its height.

entries.symptom: A link in /llms.txt returns 404 (e.g. /use-cases/internet-abroad).
entries.cause: llms.txt is a static hand-maintained file in public/ and drifted from the real route (the guide is /travel/internet-abroad).
entries.fix: Correct the URL; the llms.txt test now fails if any linked URL is not in the sitemap.

entries.symptom: On phones /esim/* pages can be panned sideways; mobile emulation reports window.innerWidth 479 at a 375px viewport while every element measures <=375 and the fixed cookie banner stretches to 479.
entries.cause: The plan table's scroll wrapper (overflow-x-auto) was not positioned, so the table's sr-only (position:absolute) caption and 'Buy' header used the page as containing block and escaped both the scroller and main's overflow-x-hidden; the 'Buy' header sat at x~479 in the 500px table.
entries.fix: Add `relative` to the wrapper. To find such culprits: in a 375px isMobile page, hide candidates one by one and watch window.innerWidth return to 375.

entries.symptom: Tapping a shared package link (https://esim.uplisoft.com/pkg/{id}) in WhatsApp on an Android phone with eSim2you installed from Google Play opens the web 'get the app' page instead of the app. The app manifest, assetlinks.json and Google's Digital Asset Links API all look correct.
entries.root_cause: assetlinks.json listed only the upload-key SHA-256. Play App Signing re-signs Play Store installs with Google's app signing key, so the installed app's cert did not match and Android marked esim.uplisoft.com unverified.
entries.fix: Add the Play Console 'App signing key certificate' SHA-256 to ANDROID_SHA256_CERT_FINGERPRINTS next to the upload key. Deploy, purge Cloudflare cache for /.well-known/assetlinks.json, then on the device run `adb shell pm verify-app-links --re-verify com.uplisoft.velocityesim` (or reinstall), because Android caches the failed verification. Check with `adb shell pm get-app-links com.uplisoft.velocityesim`.

entries.symptom: On an Android phone, the /pkg/{id} landing shows only 'Download on the App Store' and 'Get it on Google Play' with no 'Open in the app' button.
entries.root_cause: Platform was detected with /Android/i on navigator.userAgent. In 'Desktop site' mode the browser sends a desktop Linux UA, so the page fell into the 'other' (desktop) branch.
entries.fix: Use detectMobilePlatform() (UA + userAgentData.platform + touch on Linux/Mac) everywhere the landing pages choose a platform.

entries.symptom: A locally installed Android build (pnpm android / expo run:android) opens https://esim.uplisoft.com/pkg/... in the browser even though Play installs open the app. `adb shell pm get-app-links com.uplisoft.velocityesim` shows esim.uplisoft.com: 1024 and Signatures FA:C6:17:45:...
entries.root_cause: Debug builds are signed with android/app/debug.keystore (the public Android debug key), which is intentionally not listed in assetlinks.json, so App Link verification fails.
entries.fix: Not a bug for store users. To test on a dev phone: `adb shell pm set-app-links --package com.uplisoft.velocityesim 2 esim.uplisoft.com`, or install a release-signed build (pnpm android:release:apk:arm64). Do not add the debug fingerprint to assetlinks.json.

entries.symptom: /xtripplany Test connection shows 'OpenAI error (400): Bad Request' (or a working key suddenly fails after Save), and the API key field is pre-filled with dots and a blue autofill background.
entries.root_cause: Chrome autofilled a saved browser password into the type=password API key input (autoComplete='off' is ignored on password fields). A non-empty field makes Test send it and Save overwrite the stored provider key.
entries.fix: Input now uses autoComplete='new-password'. If it still appears filled, clear the field before Save/Test.

entries.symptom: Checkout order summary / plan info said 'United States covers 1 countries' for a local plan.
entries.root_cause: The catalog sends a one-country coverage list for local plans, and the coverage line rendered for any non-empty list.
entries.fix: lib/checkoutSummary.ts only returns a coverage list for bundles with more than one country (phase 5, 2026-10-01).

entries.symptom: On /checkout/failed the action buttons were 23-25px tall on phones (below the 44px tap target).
entries.root_cause: The three LinkButtons used flex-1 inside a flex row that squashed their height on narrow screens.
entries.fix: Buttons keep size=lg (54px) and use w-full sm:flex-1, stacking on phones (phase 5, 2026-10-01).

entries.symptom: /signin layout shift 0.02-0.09 on load.
entries.root_cause: Google Identity Services briefly renders a fallback button next to its iframe, pushing the Apple button down.
entries.fix: Fixed-height (h-10) Google holder with its children stacked via grid-area 1/1; width logic untouched (phase 5, 2026-10-01).

entries.symptom: /account and /account/[id] show '0 MB of 0 MB remaining' for every active plan (and unlimited plans too).
entries.root_cause: summariseUsage only read total/remaining, but the backend's usage route sends data_total_mb / data_remaining_mb / is_unlimited.
entries.fix: summariseUsage reads both shapes and handles is_unlimited (commit 379607c, 2026-10-01).

how_to_use: Grep symptom text or facts ids here before re-diagnosing an auth/routing/env issue on this app — several past incidents look like 'X is broken' but were single mis-set env values, not code bugs.
